title: Competitive exclusion and coexistence in a model with age-structured resource
summary: In this paper, we introduce and analyse a model in which a shared, age-structured resource is exploited by two competing populations through age-dependent interaction kernels. It provides a general framework for studying resource-mediated competition in epidemiology, immunology and ecology. We use integrated semigroups theory to establish the well-posedness of the model and its fundamental properties, including positivity and the existence of a global attractor.
